scope: FEAT-008 first security qualification; planned required tests, not execution evidence

cases.name: qualified-ontology-path
cases.assertion: Resolve Staff/Project/Ownership/Assignment and require active Assignment to same owning Project.

cases.name: qualified-identity-collision
cases.assertion: Same labels in different documents never join; exact typed keys and Unicode remain distinct.

cases.name: invalid-typed-expression
cases.assertion: Reject wrong endpoint role, undeclared action, boolean/string comparison, unknown operator and depth/node excess.

cases.name: mandatory-overrides-broad-grant
cases.assertion: Broad read permit plus false mandatory membership denies; forbid dominates all permits; rule permutation agrees.

cases.name: active-membership-and-owner-quantifier
cases.assertion: Active same-Project allows; inactive, missing, sibling Client/Project denies; any/all and ownerless behavior explicit.

cases.name: incomplete-trust-refusal
cases.assertion: Missing/ambiguous subject, incomplete assignment inventory, stale cut or untrusted attribute refuses entire collection.

cases.name: disclosure-dispositions
cases.assertion: Null, absence, withheld, constant transform and output type survive encoding; false permits add no obligations; absent protected disposition refuses.

cases.name: protected-query-use
cases.assertion: Predicate/order/group/join/aggregate uses disclosed representation or explicit original-use action; withheld use refuses.

cases.name: native-unknown-roundtrip
cases.assertion: Preserve unknown rules and native source byte content where promised; unknown security meaning blocks interpretation.

cases.name: bun-browser-parity
cases.assertion: Same policy/facts/diagnostics and refusal outcomes in Bun and Chromium, no host globals or external requests.

cases.name: generated-invalid-policy
cases.assertion: Generate corrupted references/types/unknown members; no fabricated trusted issuer or stale classification admits.

cases.name: formal-counterexample-controls
cases.assertion: Retain SAT weakened controls and UNSAT scoped safety checks; assumptions have positive witnesses.

cases.name: read-membership
cases.assertion: Selected native ordinary identity sees exact oracle resource IDs; active/inactive/sibling/no-owner cases.

cases.name: association-endpoints
cases.assertion: Junction row/typed edge identity and endpoint direction bind faithfully; reversed/wrong-type endpoints refuse.

cases.name: collection-operators
cases.assertion: Lookup/list/count/aggregate/traversal/page all follow eligibility, including all-hidden and empty authorized sets.

cases.name: direct-storage-bypass
cases.assertion: Direct tables, child homes, property bags, raw retained bytes, files and alternate query endpoints cannot bypass admitted policy.

cases.name: native-role-escalation
cases.assertion: Ordinary identity cannot inherit/SET/adopt owner, bypass or internal roles; pool role resets between transactions.

cases.name: definer-resolution
cases.assertion: Overloads, search path, temporary objects, wrapper calls and routine PUBLIC grants cannot enlarge ordinary authority.

cases.name: logical-property-masking
cases.assertion: Original null, absence, redaction and transform differ; forbidden property never escapes bag/retained carrier.

cases.name: mask-query-semantics
cases.assertion: Filter/sort/group/join/aggregate on protected properties follow disclosed/original-authorized/prohibited modes. Raw access requires the profile-bound exact separate action; caller-selected unrelated actions, changed bindings, empty prohibited selections and incomplete original-action dependencies refuse before execution.

cases.name: unsupported-activation
cases.assertion: Unsupported path/mask/history/composition cannot install report-mode weakening; prior protected profile remains.

cases.name: private-fact-observation
cases.assertion: Authorization can consult hidden Assignment facts; ordinary direct/list/count/diagnostic paths disclose none.

cases.name: inventory-drift
cases.assertion: Change owner/grant/membership/routine/policy/column mapping after qualification; admission detects and refuses.

cases.name: receipt-source-custody
cases.assertion: Pin exact engine/build/model/policy/mapping/source/actual-role and per-case outcomes; missing or fabricated receipt refuses.

cases.name: identity-carrier-collision
cases.assertion: Same labels, hash collisions, quoted case, Unicode and composite keys cannot mix ownership or subjects.

cases.name: privileged-negative-control
cases.assertion: Excluded admin actually bypasses ordinary protection; ordinary identities cannot reach that authority.

cases.name: incomplete-collection
cases.assertion: Corrupt one required authority dependency; no silent partial rows/counts/page or success receipt.

cases.name: performance-resource-budget
cases.assertion: At 1k/100k/1M records retain plans/overhead and finite timeout refusal, with no unauthorized partial output.

cases.name: write-old-new-state
cases.assertion: Create/delete/update and ownership-change action compare original/proposed state; failed checks leave no effects.

cases.name: field-write-authority
cases.assertion: Updating forbidden field or policy attribute fails even where object write is permitted; plain SQL path cannot bypass.

cases.name: revocation-drain-barrier
cases.assertion: Hold admitted operation at final release; revoker blocks until drain and acknowledges only after release.

cases.name: streaming-revocation
cases.assertion: Revoke after first streamed page/row; profile either holds admitted guard through last release or refuses streaming before output.

cases.name: read-after-acknowledgment
cases.assertion: After assignment/grant removal acknowledges, a newly admitted read returns no revoked resources.

cases.name: old-snapshot-new-generation
cases.assertion: Begin repeatable-read before revoke, attempt first protected read after acknowledgment; restart/refuse old authority facts.

cases.name: historical-owner-current-authority
cases.assertion: Historical owner differs from current owner or key reused; current assignment with retained original owner alone governs.

cases.name: native-history-policy-eligibility
cases.assertion: Admit actual historical read only under proved native policy/compute/table profile; incompatible historical column fails closed.

cases.name: cursor-cache-rebinding
cases.assertion: Change caller/query/policy/assignment/mapping/data cut; old cursor or cache token cannot bypass fresh admission.

cases.name: derived-copy-feed-propagation
cases.assertion: Serving copies, journals, tombstones, provenance, exports and feed checkpoints preserve declared policy and completeness.

cases.name: missing-custody-or-guard
cases.assertion: Delete retained owner or make guard/fact provider unavailable; refuse without hidden counts or effects.

cases.name: activation-rollback
cases.assertion: Fail policy/mapping migration midway; prior protection survives, and downgrade never broadens ordinary access.

cases.name: authority-change-exhaustiveness
cases.assertion: Assignment activation, role changes, subject remap and relevant attributes advance authority and invalidate stale decisions.

cases.name: effective-date-boundary
cases.assertion: Trusted clock crosses assignment expiry during operation; lease/coordination profile preserves declared cut or refuses.
